name: forum-post-card
title: Forum Post Card
description: A dark forum post card (community, author, title, body, vote and comment counts) rises in, gets an upvote with a spring and a count change, then drops out.
useWhen: A forum or community post needs to appear on screen as a quote, a reaction or social proof.
A like or upvote moment with a springy press should land inside five seconds.
avoidWhen: It should look like one specific real site: this card is deliberately generic.
A thread with many replies: use a chat flow block.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)
